name: Yamanashi Chiharu
source:
Chief Patissier of the confectionery store "Primrose". After paying off her parents' debts, she studied confectionery and went to France to study.

After returning to Japan, she was invited by Megu, who had worked at the same place before, to become a patissier at Primrose, a pastry store.

She is now like a mentor to apprentice patissier Sakura, she is trying her best to teach her all the skills she has in making fresh pastries.

[From [url=http://www.studio-74.net/works/works-patisserie.html]official site[/url]]
